answer.reason: The verses tell of Zerubbabel's deeds in rebuilding the altar and the house of God at Jerusalem.

clauses.english: built the altar of the God of Israel at Jerusalem with Jeshua
clauses.quote: builded the altar of the God of Israel, to offer burnt offerings thereon

clauses.english: refused the adversaries' offer to help build the house of God
clauses.quote: Ye have nothing to do with us to build an house unto our God

clauses.english: obeyed the LORD's word through Haggai and worked on the house of the LORD
clauses.quote: the LORD stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel

doubts: The Matthew 1:12-13 verses are only a genealogy and were not used; Zorobabel there may be the same man.
EZR 3:8 only says he began the work with others; the foundation-laying is not clearly his alone, so it was left out in favour of the altar and the later work.
ZEC 4:9 states a prophecy that his hands laid the foundation, which was not used as an event.
